title: Gauge: target/goal marker

complexity.rationale: Reuses the same value-to-angle mapping already built for the current-value needle/fill, applied to a second data field. No open design questions and no new interaction system - just the same precedented angle math and a marker mark applied once more.

summary: Adds an optional target marker to Gauge, showing a goal value on the arc distinct from the current aggregated value.
requirements: Accept a target data field; when present, render a marker on the arc at the angle corresponding to the target's value, using the same scale as the current value.
Accept an optional targetLabel data field; when present, display it near the marker instead of the target's raw numeric value.
The target marker renders in addition to, and visually distinct from, the needle or fill indicating the current value.
The target marker is available in both needle mode and fill mode.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: clamp the marker's position to the nearest scale bound rather than rendering it off the arc
no marker renders; existing needle/fill behavior is unaffected

edgeCases.case: target and current value are equal
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: both the marker and the needle/fill render at the same angle without one obscuring the other

edgeCases.case: long targetLabel text at a small rendered size
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: truncate with an ellipsis rather than overlapping the arc or center text

crossCutting.notes: requiresNewSignalOrScale: the target's value needs its own angle computation alongside the existing current-value angle, following the same pattern already established for the aggregated value. requiresS1S2Parity is false because Gauge is S2-only.

implementationPlan.change: Add optional target and targetLabel fields to the public Gauge contract.
Compute the target's angle from its data field using the same value-to-angle mapping already used for the aggregated value.
Render a marker mark at the target's angle, with optional label text.
Expose target and targetLabel on the public GaugeProps.
Add a story showing a gauge with a target marker distinct from the current value.

openQuestions: planning/specs/schema.json's chartType enum has no 'gauge' value; this spec uses the 'chart' fallback until 'gauge' is added (ideally to the pre-alpha list), at which point this file should move to planning/specs/pre-alpha/gauge/.
